visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A figure with a human body and a digitally overlaid cat head (gray and white) wearing a gray zippered hoodie and baggy white trousers performs a shuffle dance on a 'Dancerush Stardom' arcade machine. The character's hands are mostly tucked into the hoodie sleeves or moving rhythmically at their sides. The floor of the arcade machine consists of illuminated tiles that change colors in sync with the music. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-close shot of the same character dancing on a different section of the platform, bordered by red and black safety railings. The background shows other arcade machines like 'Mario Kart' and passers-by in a typical indoor gaming center environment. (3) The shot returns to a wider angle, showing the character's full body as they continue the rapid footwork on the glowing dance floor. The lighting is dominated by the neon blues and purples of the arcade cabinet and the general bright overhead lights of the venue.
